glad: We are glad you are ready to serve and make a generational impact in your community, Africa and the diaspora.
intro: This short guide walks you through your own dashboard, step by step, and shows you exactly what to tap.

scenes.text: This is your home in WDOS. Everything about your journey, your chapter and your network starts here.
Tap Seven-day journey to take your next step. One short step each day, and you become an active member.
Tap My chapter to see the women near you, your chapter leaders and what is happening.
Tap Referral progress to invite three women you trust. Share your own link on WhatsApp.
Tap WODDI Community to meet your chapter and your network, share news and encourage each other.
Tap Messages at the bottom to write to WODDI headquarters. You get the answer here, and by email.
The bell at the top shows what is new. Tap it to see your notifications.
Change your language here, at the top of every page. Tap Listen to hear the page read aloud.
You are ready. You can open this guide again from the menu, under How to use WDOS. No woman is left out.
